name: a position priced by its own quote
spec: SPEC.md §2 Position: Market = qty × price × multiplier; P&L = Market − Book; Avg = Book ÷ (qty × multiplier)
working: 100 X bought for 1,000; quote 12: book 1,000, avg 10, market 1,200, unrealized 200

name: a quote from another kind's source prices nothing; the last close stands; with neither there is no price
spec: SPEC.md §2 Position, Price: taken only when its source is the position's kind's; docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md: the person's own fill price is never a market price
working: X (a share) has a quote from a coin's source: not its own; its last close, 11 on 2026-03-05, prices it: market 1,100
Y has no quote and no close: its market value waits (price-unknown)

name: a short position: unrealized is book less market
spec: SPEC.md §2 Position: Book − Market for shorts
working: 100 X sold short for 1,000; quote 9: market 900, unrealized 100

name: held days are weighted by quantity
spec: SPEC.md §2 Position, Hold: quantity-weighted days since each lot was opened
working: 100 bought on Jan 1 (30 days before Jan 31), 300 on Jan 21 (10 days): (100 × 30 + 300 × 10) ÷ 400 = 15

name: a dividend of no cash is a notice, not a payment; one paid in another currency than its instrument's is its own amount
spec: SPEC.md §2 Distribution: each row keeps its native amount and a CAD amount converted on its date
working: a zero-cash dividend row: no cashflow row
a USD share's dividend paid as 10 CAD: 10.00 CAD

name: a payer's rate from its own record: the cash per unit of the latest distribution gone ex, every row counting; the schedule it states
spec: SPEC.md §2 Distribution rate: the payer's own record; docs/plans/stage-3a-sources.md, what the figures use
working: 0.10 ex Jan 15, Feb 13, Mar 13; 0.50 ex Mar 20; 0.11 ex Apr 15 paid Apr 22; the payer states 12 a year
today Apr 20: the latest gone ex is Apr 15 → 0.11 (the Mar 20 row counts as every row does; it is simply not the latest)
the next still to be paid is the Apr 15 distribution (paid Apr 22): ex 2026-04-15

name: a distribution reinvested whole pays no cash and is passed over; one with a cash part counts its cash
spec: docs/plans/stage-3a-sources.md, what the figures use: income paid; a reinvested part pays nothing
working: Z (BMO-like): 0.15 cash ex Sep 26; Dec 29: 0.15 cash and 0.12 reinvested → today Jan 10: latest gone ex is Dec 29 → its cash, 0.15
B (FBTC-like): its record's only row is 0.84031 reinvested ex Dec 29, no cash → no cash distribution gone ex yet

name: without the payer's own record nothing is worked out from the payments: the rate and the schedule wait on the payer
spec: docs/architecture.md §18: never assumed; docs/plans/stage-3a-sources.md: never filled from another source
working: G: 5.00, 5.00, 5.25 paid on 100 units, and no record of its payer read → the rate and the schedule wait on the payer
H: its payer's record read and its schedule stated, before its first distribution goes ex → the rate waits for it; the schedule stands

name: the tiles sum the stated members and count those left out
spec: docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, unknown and waiting: a tile is the sum of those stated, and says how many it left out
working: a win of 100, a loss of 40, and a deposited coin's sale: realized 60 over 2, 1 left out; win rate 0.5; profit factor 100 ÷ 40 = 2.5

name: a fund held in CAD that pays in USD: its yields take the payout at the latest rate
spec: SPEC.md §2 Income: yield on cost and current yield; docs/plans/stage-2-engine.md, rates: a live figure uses the latest rate the Bank has published
working: 100 F bought for 1,000 CAD: avg 10; quote 12
0.10 USD a month, 12 a year: 1.20 USD per unit a year; the latest rate, 1.25 on 2026-03-09 → 1.50 CAD
